notes.text: Maureen Raymond(-Castaneda) told Jim Cole that the Foreign Exchange and Country Risk group within Enron North America's Research Group produces Enron's country curves (inflation and foreign exchange forecasts).
Per Maureen Raymond, the FX and Country Risk team relies primarily on the Institute of International Finance (IIF) and talks with IIF senior Ph.D. economists when forecasting FX curves and inflation.

Maureen Raymond said country curve methodology covers macro policy mix, balance of payments, IMF program compliance, political risk and elections, debt ratios (debt-to-GDP, debt service, import coverage, FDI-to-current account), and banking system stability.
Maureen Raymond said country curves are updated on request from Enron business units or RAC; business units must have curves updated before Risk Assessment and Control evaluates projects.

Lenders asked (via Jirayut 'Jay' Rungsrithong, Ramon Rodriguez, Jim Cole, Sept 2000) who prepares Enron's country curves, the criteria, and update frequency; the owner forwarded Maureen's answer to his AOL address.
